title: base-probes-report-to-the-watch
intention: Every standing WATCHME probe berthed in cairn/tools/base reports to harbor_master's watch verb with {ticket, holds, finding} stated against its own ticket's falsifier, and each spec names that receiver; a probe whose data cannot be stated that way sends its ticket to FIXME instead.
why: Every standing probe in cairn/tools/base mails harbor_master with no verb and nothing reads it (835b5736bf2b D2); a88d6a368cfb built the watch verb that uses a WATCHME finding. Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a: build the receivers, and where none can use the data the ticket goes to FIXME.
traces_to: 835b5736bf2b's falsifier (zero probe-bearing standing specs lack a receiver) and Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a ('for all watchmes that we built probes for but not recievers, i think we just build the recievers'; no sensible receiver -> FIXME); the 2026-09-30 ruling that a probe's data must have a consumer that USES it; Law 1 (watch_carry states the holds/ticket/finding rule once instead of 90 times); RULE 1 (the build stays inside cairn/tools/base; harbor_master is reached only through its bus verb)
how: cairn/tools/base/probe.py gains watch_carry(ticket_id, carry, *, fails=None, holds=None): exactly one of fails (trigger-shaped (now, context) -> bool, the falsifier failing) or holds ((context) -> bool) is given; the returned carry runs the probe's own carry, moves any 'ticket' path it returned to 'ticket_path', and sets ticket=<12-hex id>, holds=<bool>, finding=<non-empty str when holds is False>; a raising carry or predicate reads as holds False with the raise as the finding (a broken probe is a broken WATCHME). Then, per standing probe under cairn/tools/base/probes (21 on PROVED/WATCHME tickets, measured 2026-10-03): read its trigger against its ticket's falsifier. 18 triggers mean the falsifier is failing (or the survey is hollow/vacuous): PROBE gets verb='watch' and carry=watch_carry(<id>, _carry, fails=_trigger). the_casting_door_has_callers (23089d52d805) fires on any arrival, so holds = no ticket journaled beside the door and none unjournaled. the_seed_versus_living_delta (13758831632c) fires only on DELTA, which is its claim holding; its trigger widens to any gate tree in hand (DELTA or NONE) and holds = status != NONE. gate_parameters_adjust_from_feedback (b0c0c47835c1) carries an LLM's proposed gate-parameter adjustment, not a verdict, and only the gate's own door (unbuilt) could receive it: its ticket goes to FIXME through harbor_master's watch verb with that lack, and its probe is untouched. Each of the 20 converted specs gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} through the artifact door. Proof under cairn/tools/base/proofs.
falsifier: GREEN when every ticket at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme.probe sits under cairn/tools/base has a probe whose PROBE posts verb 'watch' to 'harbor_master' and whose payload over live data carries ticket == that ticket's id, holds a bool, and a non-empty finding whenever holds is False; every such spec names receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} and watchme_spec_error names no receiver fault; watch_carry turns a failing trigger into holds False, a quiet one into holds True, and a raising carry or predicate into holds False naming the raise; and b0c0c47835c1 stands at FIXME with its lack named. RED if any standing base spec lacks the receiver, if a converted payload's ticket is a path or another id, or if a probe whose trigger fires on good news reports holds False for it. WRONG INTENT if a base probe's data has a plausible reader other than its own ticket's FIXME that only Akien could name.
watchme: none, because what this child's probes say is read by harbor_master's watch verb (a88d6a368cfb, PROVED), and whether they ever fire is 164da559823d's and acb4ecd84364's watch (CairnCommons/tickets/164da559823d-*.json); a probe on probes reporting would need a receiver of its own.
children: none, because the change is one helper in probe.py, 20 PROBE declarations and their specs, one FIXME, all inside cairn/tools/base.
builder_notes: A Haiku builder would ask: (1) The helper's exact shape: in cairn/tools/base/probe.py, def watch_carry(ticket_id: str, carry=None, *, fails=None, holds=None) -> Callable[[dict], dict]; ValueError unless ticket_id matches ^[0-9a-f]{12}$; TypeError unless exactly one of fails/holds is callable. The carrier: out = dict(carry(context)) if carry else {} (a raise -> out = {}, held False, finding 'the probe's carry raised: <Type>: <msg>'); if 'ticket' in out: out['ticket_path'] = out.pop('ticket'); held = not bool(fails(None, context)) or bool(holds(context)) (a raise -> False, finding names it); finding = out.get('finding') as str, falling back when held is False and it is blank to 'the probe reads its ticket's falsifier as failing and its carry names no finding'; return {**out, 'ticket': ticket_id, 'holds': held, 'finding': finding}. (2) Which probes and how: fails=_trigger for 74d4124bc0e7 device_claims_match_shims, 73c9d3093973 an_emission_is_one_file_named_by_its_pointer, fb7e5b78b99b are_crossing_fingerprints_verified, 95e3b9911dd0 no_ticket_carries_a_stored_chart_chain, 0146df77dae1 does_the_bounce_blame_the_right_party, 9e7867aa1056 the_ticket_write_door_has_callers, 1796a5f72895 no_component_reaches_proved_with_an_uncharted_build, c6017f156442 every_boundary_crossing_lands_in_the_logs_tree, 78cab05e93af does_optional_mean_never_carried, 54f519a1f728 a_pickup_is_witnessed, 4a105acd1190 bounce_returns_to_sender, 968fdf52a10f hand_spelled_instance_paths, 6ec9b384b451 the_vocabulary_is_written_not_just_legal, 8529f0e413b2 unchartered_build_edits, c2460ae6c3d1 the_durability_lane_refuses, 7cb1989e7825 does_the_mail_lane_get_worked, 16047f83eb88 does_the_gradation_find_a_reader, d2ecdb867bc9 no_ticket_carries_a_stored_crossing. holds=_holds for 23089d52d805 the_casting_door_has_callers (_holds: survey shows no journaled_beside and no unjournaled) and 13758831632c the_seed_versus_living_delta (_trigger becomes status in ('DELTA', 'NONE'); _holds: status != 'NONE'). Each PROBE(...) gains verb='watch' and carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, fails=_trigger | holds=_holds); to stays 'harbor_master'. (3) b0c0c47835c1: probe untouched; post watch {ticket: 'b0c0c47835c1', holds: false, finding: <the lack>} to harbor_master from sender 'cc'. (4) Specs: receiver written into the 20 converted tickets' watchme through cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write. (5) Proof: cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_base_probes_report_to_the_watch.py, PROVES {'<this id>': {'all': 'test_base_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}, teeth: watch_carry_states_holds_and_finding (fixture predicates), every_standing_base_probe_posts_watch (live payloads, invariants only), every_standing_base_spec_names_the_receiver, the_unreceivable_probe_sent_its_ticket_to_fixme, and the composite.

decisions.text: D1: the helper — In cairn/tools/base/probe.py, beside by_text, add `def watch_carry(ticket_id: str, carry=None, *, fails=None, holds=None) -> Callable[[dict], dict]`. Raise ValueError unless re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{12}', ticket_id); raise TypeError unless exactly one of fails/holds is callable. The returned carrier(context): out = dict(carry(context)) if carry else {} — on any Exception: out = {}, held = False, finding = f"the probe's carry raised: {type(e).__name__}: {e}"; else if 'ticket' in out: out['ticket_path'] = out.pop('ticket'); held = (not bool(fails(None, context))) if fails else bool(holds(context)) — a raise gives held False and finding f"the probe's {'fails' if fails else 'holds'} predicate raised: {type(e).__name__}: {e}"; finding = out.get('finding') if str else ''; when held is False and finding is blank, finding = "the probe reads its ticket's falsifier as failing and its carry names no finding"; return {**out, 'ticket': ticket_id, 'holds': held, 'finding': finding}. Docstring cites 835b5736bf2b D2 and a88d6a368cfb (the watch verb's {ticket, holds, finding} contract) and why the address rides as ticket_path (the 2026-08-05 owning_ticket ruling is kept).

D2: the 18 fails-probes — In each of these files under cairn/tools/base/probes/: device_claims_match_shims.py (74d4124bc0e7), an_emission_is_one_file_named_by_its_pointer.py (73c9d3093973), are_crossing_fingerprints_verified.py (fb7e5b78b99b), no_ticket_carries_a_stored_chart_chain.py (95e3b9911dd0), does_the_bounce_blame_the_right_party.py (0146df77dae1), the_ticket_write_door_has_callers.py (9e7867aa1056), no_component_reaches_proved_with_an_uncharted_build.py (1796a5f72895), every_boundary_crossing_lands_in_the_logs_tree.py (c6017f156442), does_optional_mean_never_carried.py (78cab05e93af), a_pickup_is_witnessed.py (54f519a1f728), bounce_returns_to_sender.py (4a105acd1190), hand_spelled_instance_paths.py (968fdf52a10f), the_vocabulary_is_written_not_just_legal.py (6ec9b384b451), unchartered_build_edits.py (8529f0e413b2), the_durability_lane_refuses.py (c2460ae6c3d1), does_the_mail_lane_get_worked.py (7cb1989e7825), does_the_gradation_find_a_reader.py (16047f83eb88), no_ticket_carries_a_stored_crossing.py (d2ecdb867bc9) — add `_TICKET_ID = "<its id>"` after the imports (does_the_mail_lane_get_worked.py already has one), import watch_carry from cairn.tools.base.probe, and in `PROBE = Probe(...)` set `verb="watch"` and replace `carry=_carry` with `carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, fails=_trigger)`. Change nothing else; `to` stays 'harbor_master'.

D3: the two holds-probes — cairn/tools/base/probes/the_casting_door_has_callers.py (23089d52d805): add `_TICKET_ID`, a `_holds(context)` returning `not s['journaled_beside'] and not s['unjournaled']` for s = _survey(context), and PROBE gets verb='watch', carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, holds=_holds). cairn/tools/base/probes/the_seed_versus_living_delta.py (13758831632c): _trigger returns d['status'] in ('DELTA', 'NONE'); add `_holds(context)` returning once(context, 'delta', _compute_delta)['status'] != 'NONE'; _carry's finding becomes 'seed-versus-living delta detected' on DELTA and 'the gate tree stands constructed and no dial has moved off its seed' on NONE; PROBE gets verb='watch', carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, holds=_holds).

D4: the moved address in test_deviceness — cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_deviceness.py line ~178 reads payload['ticket'] as the owning ticket's path; change it to assert payload['ticket_path'].endswith('device-ness-is-decided-at-the-shim.json') and payload['ticket'] == '74d4124bc0e7'. Then run every cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_*.py that imports cairn.tools.base.probes (test_phase_write_rate, test_ticket_write_door_callers, test_deviceness, test_watchme_spec, test_cast_ticket, test_llm_inspection_probe, test_the_stones_are_pushed, test_bounce_raises_the_mail_trouble, test_transitions, test_does_optional_probe, test_emission_gate, test_beat_probes) plus cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py's watch-probe tooth; each must read as before the build.

D5: the proof — Create cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_base_probes_report_to_the_watch.py, PROVES = {'8ecb99998254': {'all': 'test_base_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}. Root the commons at the main tree when run in a worktree (the _main_tree() pattern of cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_watch_receives_a_finding.py). Teeth: watch_carry_states_holds_and_finding (fixture predicates: fails True -> holds False, finding non-empty; fails False -> holds True; holds-predicate both ways; raising carry and raising predicate -> holds False with the exception type in the finding; carry {'ticket': '/x.json'} -> ticket_path '/x.json', ticket the id; ValueError on 'abc', TypeError on both or neither); every_standing_base_probe_posts_watch (for every ticket in the commons whose cursor is [PROVED] or [WATCHME...] and whose watchme.probe starts with 'cairn/tools/base/probes/', excluding b0c0c47835c1: import the module, PROBE.verb == 'watch', PROBE.to == 'harbor_master', payload = PROBE.payload({}) has ticket == that id, isinstance(holds, bool), and a non-empty str finding when holds is False — invariants only, never a holds value); every_standing_base_spec_names_the_receiver (same population: watchme.receiver == {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', 'in': 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} and watchme_spec_error(watchme) names no receiver fault); the_unreceivable_probe_sent_its_ticket_to_fixme (b0c0c47835c1's workflow_and_state carries '[FIXME' and its fixme list has a kind 'watchme' entry); and the composite calling them all.

D6: the specs' receiver — For each of the 20 tickets in D2/D3, add watchme['receiver'] = {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', 'in': 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} via cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write(path, text, verb='cast', why='<id>: the watchme names its receiver (8ecb99998254)').

D7: b0c0c47835c1 to FIXME — From cairn.tools.bus_client import reach; reach('harbor_master').request(sender='cc', to='harbor_master', verb='watch', why='8ecb99998254: no receiver can use this probe', body={'ticket': 'b0c0c47835c1', 'holds': False, 'finding': "its probe gate_parameters_adjust_from_feedback carries an LLM-proposed gate-parameter adjustment through a resolver nobody injects, and only the gate's own door — unbuilt — could receive it; no receiver can use the data (Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a: no sensible receiver -> FIXME)"}). Print the reply; it must be accepted with acted 'fixme'. If the running bus predates the watch verb, the reply refuses the verb: then construct HarborMasterDevice() in process and call _handle_watch with the same envelope (the live crossing roots).

D8: green, then commit — Run cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_base_probes_report_to_the_watch.py (exit 0). Commit probe.py, the 20 probes, test_deviceness.py and the proof with message '8ecb99998254: base probes report to the watch' in the background (the commit runs the reseal ladder); commit the commons.

Measured 2026-10-03 by grep: all 20 probe files under cairn/tools/base/probes declare 'def _trigger(now, context)', 'def _carry(context)' and one 'PROBE = Probe(' with trigger=_trigger and carry=_carry; only does_the_mail_lane_get_worked.py has a _TICKET_ID, at line 42, value "7cb1989e7825", which is correct — leave it as is and add none there.

Measured 2026-10-03: the_casting_door_has_callers.py has _survey(context) -> dict with keys arrivals, journaled_beside, unjournaled (lines 95-96), _trigger at line 113 and _carry at line 120 returning a dict; no _holds exists. the_seed_versus_living_delta.py has _compute_delta() -> {status: SEEDED|NONE|DELTA, deltas} at line 27, _trigger(now, context) -> bool at line 52 returning d['status'] == 'DELTA' (a bool, not a dict), _carry(context) -> dict at line 65 with keys finding, delta, ticket; no _holds exists; _OWNING_TICKET is 'a-gate-is-a-class' and _TICKET_ID is added as '13758831632c'.

Measured 2026-10-03: test_deviceness.py line 178 reads 'assert payload["ticket"].endswith("device-ness-is-decided-at-the-shim.json")' over PROBE.payload({}) of device_claims_match_shims; it is the only base proof reading a converted PROBE's payload ticket. test_cast_ticket.py:273 checks '23089d52d805' in str(P.PROBE.carry(ctx())['ticket']) and still passes with the id; test_does_optional_probe.py:206 reads SUT._carry (the raw carry, unchanged) and tester's test_hollow.py:1141 reads _trigger/_carry/_enough only.

The pattern to copy verbatim (test_watch_receives_a_finding.py lines 43-47): def _main_tree() -> Path: run ['git','-C',str(_REPO_ROOT),'rev-parse','--path-format=absolute','--git-common-dir'] with capture_output=True, text=True; return Path(stdout.strip()).parent if returncode == 0 else _REPO_ROOT. Here _REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] (cairn/tools/base/proofs/x.py -> repo) and the commons the proof reads is _main_tree().parent / 'CairnCommons' — in the main tree that is ../CairnCommons, in a /tmp hollow worktree it is still the live commons. Tickets are read from <commons>/tickets/*.json.

Measured 2026-10-03: HarborMasterDevice.__init__(self) takes no arguments (device.py:45); _handle_watch(self, envelope: dict) -> dict (device.py:152) reads envelope['sender'] and envelope['body'] and returns {accepted, acted, said, verb, device}. bus.request(...) returns the reply envelope whose 'body' key carries that dict (codemother/deposit.py:39 reads reply['body']), so check reply['body']['accepted'] is True and reply['body']['acted'] == 'fixme'. Run it as a one-off python3 script from the repo root with PYTHONPATH=. ; for the fallback, the envelope is {'sender': 'cc', 'to': 'harbor_master', 'verb': 'watch', 'why': <same>, 'body': <same>}.
